highlights: Burp AI Agent is an extension for Burp Suite that integrates AI into your security workflow.
Use local models or cloud providers, connect external AI agents via MCP, and let passive/active scanners find vulnerabilities while you focus on manual testing.
10 AI Backends — Burp AI (built-in), Ollama, LM Studio, NVIDIA NIM, Generic OpenAI-compatible, Gemini CLI, Claude CLI, Codex CLI, OpenCode CLI, Copilot CLI.
53+ MCP Tools — Let Claude Desktop (or any MCP client) drive Burp autonomously.
Burp Scan Skill — Use your preferred AI coding assistant (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, etc.) as a scanner via MCP.
The extension auto-installs the bundled profiles into ~/.burp-ai-agent/AGENTS/ on first run.
Open the AI Agent tab and go to Settings.
Select Extensions > Burp AI Agent > Analyze this request.
